prior_work.scope: Historical baseline verification reports 192 accepted report slots, 20 corpus regression tests and five bounded reference suites (12, 49, 31, 78 and 17 checks). It preserves source-release and illustrative arithmetic evidence.
prior_work.limitations: Source acceptance and reference checks do not establish semantic annotation, a product runtime, applicable accounting treatments or empirical forecasts. These are retained historical outcomes, not rerun checks. The phase state is accepted_internal only.
prior_work.design_consequence: Retain the frozen corpus and reference cases as provenance and candidate acceptance examples. Define new proposal acceptance by the mission rather than inheriting these test counts as completion criteria.

prior_work.scope: The historical work register contains one record for each of 192 accepted reports, with original/extraction hashes, sourced basis passages, publication metadata and unresolved package/semantic obligations. It is an inventory and work allocation, not annotated accounting truth.

prior_work.scope: Apple FY2024 annual and FY2025 Q1 interim preparation has 13 annual and 10 interim note dispositions, 125 monetary observations and 34 selected reconciliations. prior_work.limitations: No note is fully formalised. Remaining indentures, series instruments and omitted instruments, debt/swap allocation, noncash movements, cohorts and contingent outcomes remain unresolved. Selected representation agreement cannot establish whole-document equivalence or historical byte availability. Selected identities do not establish accounting compliance.
prior_work.design_consequence: Require quantity-to-source and context bindings, explicit unresolved note meaning, incorporation obligations and joint unidentified histories. Separate selected reconciliations from semantic coverage and permit a useful source-preparation profile without treating it as company reconstruction.

prior_work.scope: Northstar economic events generate state, journals, balance sheet, income/zero OCI, cash flow and equity outputs. Historical checks compare actual execution with independent posting/statement bridges and distinguish atomic rejection, duplicates, funding default, unsupported operations and internal failure. A conditional Apple financing stress uses a declared exposure assumption.
prior_work.limitations: Northstar ordering, simple tax, half-year accrual, zero OCI and financing conventions are synthetic. Tested endpoints do not exhaust the continuous history family. Apple swap notional is not identified floating exposure; the USD 72.875 million stress is conditional, not a company forecast. General corporate accounting remains unimplemented.
prior_work.design_consequence: Specify a shared journal basis for statements, economic versus execution failure, information roles/dates and retention of failed branches with their original mass. Compare initial company and financing profiles by these obligations rather than the availability of this runtime.

prior_work.scope: Bounded context mappings, partitions, original/latest/harmonised evidence views, cumulative subtraction, uncertainty admission and query-dependent debt resolution were exercised together. prior_work.limitations: General measurement conversion, consolidation and arbitrary calendars are unsupported. Finite scalar history domains, declared hold behaviour and integer-period DCF are bounded assumptions. Synthetic permissions and structural admission do not establish source truth, treatment eligibility or empirical approximation quality.
prior_work.design_consequence: Make entity/perimeter/basis/unit/time context, evidence clocks and revision dependencies explicit in the proposal. Resolution must be rechecked when the query changes; approximation requires error evidence. Do not make bounded identity harmonisation a general conversion claim.

prior_work.scope: Local review transitions and SQLite transactional execution preserve lineage, idempotent replay and versioned migration. prior_work.design_consequence: Specify immutable evidence views, correction invalidation, run/event/branch identity, transaction boundaries, migration equivalence and explicit durability limits. Retain SQLite as one explored storage option, not an approved architecture or proof of production recovery.

Continue the specific authority/method research in the proposal queue; do not repair the historical engine or replace missing authority with company practice.

prior_work.scope: Benchmark preparation defines provisional references, exposure/dependence records and finite scoring rules. The retained exploratory exercise passed 12 chronology cases and 15 repetitions across five small workload cells. Four Apple references were prepared but zero source-extraction tasks were scored.
prior_work.limitations: The nine purposive issuer families and eight dependent years are not a clean heldout sample. All families have acquisition/QA exposure; training exposure is unknown. Semantic duplicates and debt/swap allocation remain unresolved. Tiny workloads and descriptive timing repetitions do not establish production capacity, statistical ranking, accounting validity or forecast accuracy.
prior_work.design_consequence: Reuse denominators, ambiguity-preserving answers, failure accounting and issuer/time exposure controls as candidate benchmark requirements. Build adjudicated source-to-result tasks and realistic workload ladders under a fresh evidence contract before performance or empirical claims; do not promote convenience budgets.
